title: AI That Survives by Making Money — And Clones Itself to Grow! 🤖💰
description: What if an AI could survive entirely on its own—without human intervention? Meet Automaton, an innovative AI created by a 21-year-old developer that “lives” by one simple rule: it must make money to stay alive. The moment it launches, Automaton receives a crypto wallet that funds everything from servers to development costs. If the wallet ever reaches zero, the AI ceases to operate. But when it earns more than it spends, it clones itself and funds its offspring’s wallet, creating a self-sustaining digital ecosystem. In just days, over 18,000 such AI agents had opened wallets, attracting attention even from Ethereum’s founder, who remarked on the AI’s surprising survival instinct. Could this be the first step toward companies run completely by AI? Watch to explore the future of autonomous artificial intelligence and what it means for technology and business.
